name: Infinity removes Infinite Shield's cooldown (#2990)
contract: Infinity 706128 carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x200; EffectBasePoints -15001 resolves to -15000 with DieSides 1. Infinite Shield 520457 has SpellFamilyFlags word0 512, RecoveryTime exactly 15000, CategoryRecoveryTime 0 and AttributesEx3 0, so the modifier cancels the whole cooldown, which is the tooltip "Removes the cooldown of Infinite Shield." Native path only: AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod and Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns, whose `if (rec < 0) rec = 0;` clamp keeps the result at zero rather than negative.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Infinite Shield keeps its 15 sec cooldown without the talent
Infinite Shield has no cooldown left with the talent
